verdict.rationale: The pack shows built-in observability, event subscriptions (Queues) for custom workflows, and Logpush/Analytics-oriented MCP servers, but nowhere documents a native alerting feature that lets a devops-lead configure threshold/condition-based alerts delivered via chat or email. Event subscriptions could theoretically be wired into a custom notifier, but no evidence shows an out-of-the-box alert/notification configuration UI or API for Workers.
